IT professionals - KONE Corporation Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Product Designer, Business Intelligence (BI) to join our Business Intelligence team in Chennai (preferred)/Pune .   This role focuses on designing, conceptualizing, and enhancing BI products that enable data-driven decision-making across KONE. The BI Product Designer collaborates closely with product owners, users, architects, and developers to ensure BI solutions are intuitive, scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards. S/he actively collaborates with stakeholders inside and outside KONE IT to ensure that BI solutions deliver tangible value, meet data governance requirements, and align with KONE’s cybersecurity and architecture standards. In addition to product design responsibilities, this role may also include hands-on development tasks in Fabric & Power BI. By combining design thinking, data modelling, and iterative solution development, the BI Product Designer ensures BI products evolve according to the product vision and roadmap while enabling informed, data-driven decision-making across KONE. Main responsibilities  BI Product Design & User Collaboration   Analyze business and user needs, translating them into BI product concepts, functional specifications, and backlog items.  Work with product owners, process owners, and key users to define requirements and acceptance criteria.  Take ownership of the design and conceptualization of BI dashboards, data models, and analytical product Design fitforpurpose and fitforuse BI solutions that consider both functional (analytics, usability, accessibility) and nonfunctional (security, performance, scalability) requirements. Create & maintain high quality technical design documents, including data models, logic descriptions, and architectural diagrams in Confluence & Sharepoint.   Provide clarifications and support to developers, data engineers, and testers during implementation, verification, and validation Identify data-quality issues early in the pipeline and escalate appropriately. Troubleshoot issues related to BI data sources, model performance, and platform connectivity.  Monitor & Optimize BI solutions for performance, scalability, and security.  IT Product Operations Support Operations teams in managing major incidents and other critical issues related to BI product operations.
